name: worktree-guidelines
description: Enforces a review-gated worktree workflow. You MUST use this when working in a git worktree: on entry it steers you to load or build a per-language guidelines skill and code through the coder agent; a reviewer agent runs code-review and writes a pass marker; exit and merge-into-main are BLOCKED until the reviewed HEAD is merged and the tree is clean. Use for any isolated feature work in a worktree.
